import pandas as pd
import re
from typing import Dict, Any

def clean(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Fix label variants in 'species' and 'island'
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    species_map = {' Adelie': 'Adelie', 'Adelie ': 'Adelie', ' Adelie ': 'Adelie'}
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace(species_map)
    island_map = {'biscoe': 'Biscoe'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace(island_map)
    
    # Convert 'body_mass_g' from text to numeric, handling numbers with commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(r',', ''), errors='coerce')
    
    # Validate and correct numeric ranges
    mask = (
        (df['bill_length_mm'] < 30) | (df['bill_length_mm'] > 60) |
        (df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235) |
        (df['body_mass_g'].notnull() & ((df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500)))
    df = df[~mask]
    
    # Ensure 'year' is integer and within allowed range
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce').astype(int)
    df = df[(df['year'] == 2007) | (df['year'] == 2008) | (df['year'] == 2009)]
    
    # Keep 'sex' missing if missing, do not impute
    
    # Keep id column
    return df

def answer(df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    # Group by species
    grouped = df.groupby('species')
    result: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    # Compute mean body mass for each species, drop groups with no valid body_mass_g
    for name, group in grouped:
        valid = group.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])
        if not valid.empty:
            label = name
            value = valid['body_mass_g'].mean()
            result[label] = round(value, 1)
    # If all species present, add 'all' key
    all_species = set(df['species'].dropna().unique())
    if set(result.keys()) == all_species:
        result['all'] = df[df['body_mass_g'].notnull()]['body_mass_g'].mean()
    # Remove keys with missing group (shouldn't happen here, but just in case)
    result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != 'all' or k in all_species}
    return result
